Welcome to the retreat of **MuViSU**, the Multivariate Visualisation and Statistical Understanding group. See [github.com/MuViSU](https://github.com/MuViSU) for more about the organisation and its materials.

The retreat is a two-day, in-person opportunity to share research, plan projects, and collaborate on software, teaching and visualisation ideas.

## When

Day 1 and Day 2: *dates to be confirmed*.

## Get Involved

Project ideas are contributed by attendees. Please [file an issue](https://github.com/dicook/muvisu_retreat/issues) describing an idea to work on, and working groups will be formed during the retreat.

## Program

See the [program](program.qmd) and [venue](venue.qmd) pages.

## Questions

Please file an [issue](https://github.com/dicook/muvisu_retreat/issues).
